title: ModelUsage
description: The `data` payload of `dmtool -m <model> model usage` (CLI-SPEC §6) — the model-wide usage/audit read. `usage` maps EVERY field path to the full names of the rules and computations that READ it (an empty array = read by nothing); `unreferenced` is the subset of fields nothing reads. Reading includes reaching the field through an ancestor GROUP operand, because the kernel expands a group operand recursively to every field below it: `AllFieldsFilled(/Order/Address)` reads `/Order/Address/Region/Code` while naming neither. This is DELIBERATELY wider than `where-used`, which answers the exact question 'which rules name this entity?' and does not list a rule that names an enclosing group — so the two differ on exactly those fields, by design. Fields are in model order; referrers are sorted.

usage.description: field path → the rule/computation full names that read it, whether by naming it or by naming an ancestor group (empty array = nothing reads the field)

items.description: a referencing rule's or computation's full name

unreferenced.description: the fields no rule or computation reads — the audit headline (candidates for removal, or a missing rule)
